title: The Monk and the Gun (bc30)
synopsis: Kingdom of Bhutan, 2006. Modernization has finally arrived. Having been the last country in the world to connect to the internet and television, it now faces the biggest change of all: democracy. To teach the people how to vote, authorities organise a mock election, but the locals remain unconvinced. Travelling to rural Bhutan where religion matters far more than politics, an election supervisor discovers that a monk is planning a mysterious ceremony for election day. As the first Bhutanese film released in Hong Kong, it inspired bc to launch a popular social media vote on its wall colour, widening the film's reach.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 這一年，不丹變天了！這是一場沒有硝煙的「政變」――不丹國王希望國家能蛻變成民主體系，自願捨棄王權，授命一班公務員上山下鄉舉行模擬選舉，指導一頭霧水的村民投票。一個高僧聽到消息，叫徒弟務必要在模擬選舉日帶兩把槍回來，沒有人知道他心裡盤算什麼，但覬覦著槍枝的人，可不止高僧一個……選舉日揭盅的不單是哪個候選人勝出，還有槍枝花落誰家！正在踏上民主之路的小國小民，能成為好國好民嗎？首部在港公映的不丹電影， bc 當時受其啟發，在社交媒體提議觀眾投票選擇 bc 外牆顏色，反應熱烈，令電影更廣為人知。
